description: This file defines the EmployeeDecorator class, which provides a wrapper around the Employee entity to facilitate data formatting, accessor, and mutator operations, especially related to employee details such as dates, location, and various IDs. It leverages traits for ORM support and date-time utilities.

classes.name: EmployeeDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the Employee entity that provides additional methods for data formatting, retrieving, and setting employee-related information, utilizing ORM and date helper traits for enhanced functionality.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the protected Employee instance associated with this decorator.

methods.name: getJoinedDate
methods.description: Retrieves the employee's joined date formatted as a string.

methods.name: getDrivingLicenseExpiredDate
methods.description: Retrieves the date when the employee's driving license expires, formatted as a string.

methods.name: getBirthday
methods.description: Retrieves the employee's birthday formatted as a string.

methods.name: getSmoker
methods.description: Returns whether the employee is a smoker as a boolean.

methods.name: setSmoker
methods.description: Sets the smoker status on the employee entity, accepting a nullable boolean.

methods.name: setNationality
methods.description: Sets the employee's nationality reference by ID.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the employment state of the employee, either active or terminated.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Returns the first location associated with the employee, if any.

methods.name: setLocationById
methods.description: Sets the employee's location based on a location ID, replacing existing locations.

methods.name: setJobTitleById
methods.description: Assigns a JobTitle to the employee based on a provided ID.

methods.name: setEmpStatusById
methods.description: Assigns an EmploymentStatus to the employee based on a provided ID.

methods.name: setJobCategoryById
methods.description: Assigns a JobCategory to the employee based on a provided ID.

methods.name: setSubunitById
methods.description: Assigns a Subunit to the employee based on a provided ID.

methods.name: getFirstAndLastNames
methods.description: Returns a concatenation of the employee's first and last names.

methods.name: getFullName
methods.description: Returns the full name of the employee, including middle name.
